cases.description: Boundary-correctness regression check: the task keyword 'scan' must not spuriously match `engine/testability_scanner_utils.py` just because 'scan' is a prefix-substring of the 'scanner' token inside that compound filename — and it doesn't. Zero recommendations is the correct output here, the same L23-class protection location_resolver.py established, applied to this skill's own tokenized scorer.
cases.grounding: relevance_scorer.score_relevance tokenizes the path into {'engine','testability','scanner','utils','py'} and checks exact token-set membership; 'scan' is not equal to any of those tokens (only 'scanner' is present), so no field matches, base_score is 0, and report.py never creates a FileRelevance entry for a zero-or-negative score.
